Métricas HIS (iguales)\n","metadata":{}},{"id":"3a54cdb4-5de2-4e5e-b73c-292a7929006c","cell_type":"code","source":"def his_raw(h_id, h_re):\n    d = abs(h_id)\n    return float(\"nan\") if d < EPS else 1.0 - abs(h_id - h_re) / d\n\ndef his_span(h_id, h_re, span):\n    return 1.0 - abs(h_id - h_re) / span\n\ndef z_diff(a, sa, b, sb):\n    s = math.sqrt(sa**2 + sb**2)\n    return float(\"nan\") if (s < EPS or math.isnan(s)) else (a - b) / s\n\ndef group_stats(counts, op, n):\n    labels = op.paulis.to_labels()\n    coeffs = np.real(op.coeffs)\n    vals, cnt = [], []\n    for bs, c in counts.items():\n        s = bs.replace(\" \", \"\")[-n:].zfill(n)\n        e = 0.0\n        for lab, w in zip(labels, coeffs):\n            par = 0\n            for i, ch in enumerate(lab):\n                if ch != \"I\" and s[i] == \"1\":\n                    par ^= 1\n            e += w * (1 - 2 * par)\n        vals.append(e)\n        cnt.append(c)\n    cnt = np.array(cnt, float)\n    shots = max(cnt.sum(), 1.0)\n    return np.array(vals), cnt / shots, int(shots)\n\ndef estimate_energy(groups_counts, groups_ops, n):\n    h, var = 0.0, 0.0\n    for counts, op in zip(groups_counts, groups_ops):\n        v, p, shots = group_stats(counts, op, n)\n        m = float(p @ v)\n        h += m\n        var += float(p @ (v**2) - m**2) / max(shots, 1)\n    return h, math.sqrt(max(var, 0.0))\n\nprint(\"métricas OK\")\n","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-13T16:40:51.407800Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-13T16:40:51.408471Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-13T16:40:51.420098Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-13T16:40:51.408443Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-13T16:40:51.419238Z"},"jupyter":{"source_hidden":true}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"métricas OK\n","output_type":"stream"}],"execution_count":18},{"id":"7d0e37db-7505-4e5f-9923-131f1eae8e26","cell_type":"markdown","source":"## 3. Hamiltonianos T1 y T5 (iguales)\n","metadata":{}},{"id":"8a095d41-12ca-4826-9e33-b06497e05965","cell_type":"code","source":"def plabel(n, ops):\n    s = [\"I\"] * n\n    for q, l in ops.items():\n        s[n - 1 - q] = l\n    return \"\".join(s)\n\ndef maxcut_H(n):\n    t = [(\"I\" * n, 0.5 * (n - 1))]\n    t += [(plabel(n, {i: \"Z\", i + 1: \"Z\"}), -0.5) for i in range(n - 1)]\n    return SparsePauliOp.from_list(t)\n\ndef random_pauli_H(n, seed):\n    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)\n    t = []\n    for l in \"XYZ\":\n        for i in range(n - 1):\n            t.append((plabel(n, {i: l, i + 1: l}), float(rng.normal(0, 0.5))))\n        for i in range(n):\n            t.append((plabel(n, {i: l}), float(rng.normal(0, 0.4))))\n    return SparsePauliOp.from_list(t).simplify()\n\ndef build_prep(kind, n, idle=None, qaoa=(0.8, 0.4), hea=None):\n    qc = QuantumCircuit(n)\n    if kind == \"T1\":\n        g, b = qaoa\n        qc.h(range(n))\n        for i in range(n - 1):\n            qc.cx(i, i + 1)\n            qc.rz(-g, i + 1)\n            qc.cx(i, i + 1)\n        if idle:\n            idle(qc, \"cost\")\n        qc.rx(2 * b, range(n))\n        if idle:\n            idle(qc, \"mixer\")\n    else:\n        L = hea.shape[0]\n        for l in range(L):\n            for q in range(n):\n                qc.ry(float(hea[l, q, 0]), q)\n                qc.rz(float(hea[l, q, 1]), q)\n            for i in range(n - 1):\n                qc.cx(i, i + 1)\n            if idle:\n                idle(qc, f\"L{l}\")\n    return qc\n\ndef h_ideal(prep, H):\n    return float(np.real(Statevector.from_instruction(prep).expectation_value(H)))\n\ndef spectrum_span(H):\n    ev = np.linalg.eigvalsh(H.to_matrix())\n    return float(ev[-1] - ev[0]), float(ev[0]), float(ev[-1])\n\nN = N_LOGICAL\nbest, QAOA = None, (0.8, 0.4)\nH1 = maxcut_H(N)\nfor g in np.linspace(0.2, 1.2, 12):\n    for b in np.linspace(0.1, 0.6, 10):\n        e = h_ideal(build_prep(\"T1\", N, qaoa=(g, b)), H1)\n        if best is None or e > best:\n            best, QAOA = e, (float(g), float(b))\n\nT5_SEED, T5_H, T5_HEA, t5_best = None, None, None, -1.0\n_candidates = []\nfor s in range(0, 300):\n    H = random_pauli_H(N, s)\n    span, _, _ = spectrum_span(H)\n    if span < EPS:\n        continue\n    hea = np.random.default_rng(s).uniform(0, 2 * np.pi, size=(3, N, 2))\n    hid = h_ideal(build_prep(\"T5\", N, hea=hea), H)\n    cond = abs(hid) / span\n    _candidates.append((cond, s, H, hea, hid, span))\n    if cond >= COND_MIN and cond > t5_best:\n        t5_best, T5_SEED, T5_H, T5_HEA = cond, s, H, hea\n\nif T5_H is None:\n    _candidates.sort(key=lambda x: -x[0])\n    t5_best, T5_SEED, T5_H, T5_HEA, hid5_tmp, span5_tmp = (\n        _candidates[0][0], _candidates[0][1], _candidates[0][2],\n        _candidates[0][3], _candidates[0][4], _candidates[0][5])\n    print(\"WARN T5 fallback cond=%.4f seed=%d\" % (t5_best, T5_SEED))\nelse:\n    hid5_tmp = h_ideal(build_prep(\"T5\", N, hea=T5_HEA), T5_H)\n    span5_tmp, _, _ = spectrum_span(T5_H)\n\nspan1, _, _ = spectrum_span(H1)\nspan5 = span5_tmp\nhid1 = h_ideal(build_prep(\"T1\", N, qaoa=QAOA), H1)\nhid5 = hid5_tmp\n\ndef z_groups(H):\n    terms = list(zip(H.paulis.to_labels(), np.real(H.coeffs)))\n    buckets = {\"X\": [], \"Y\": [], \"Z\": [], \"I\": []}\n    for lab, w in terms:\n        letters = set(lab) - {\"I\"}\n        if not letters:\n            buckets[\"I\"].append((lab, w))\n        elif letters <= {\"Z\"}:\n            buckets[\"Z\"].append((lab, w))\n        elif letters <= {\"X\"}:\n            buckets[\"X\"].append((lab, w))\n        elif letters <= {\"Y\"}:\n            buckets[\"Y\"].append((lab, w))\n        else:\n            buckets[\"Z\"].append((lab, w))\n    groups = []\n    for basis in (\"X\", \"Y\", \"Z\"):\n        items = buckets[basis] + (buckets[\"I\"] if basis == \"Z\" else [])\n        if not items and basis != \"Z\":\n            continue\n        if not items:\n            items = buckets[\"I\"] or [(\"I\" * N, 0.0)]\n        groups.append(dict(basis=basis, op=SparsePauliOp.from_list(items)))\n    if not groups:\n        groups = [dict(basis=\"Z\", op=H)]\n    return groups\n\nHAM = {\n    \"T1\": dict(H=H1, h_id=hid1, span=span1, groups=z_groups(H1), kind=\"T1\", qaoa=QAOA, hea=None),\n    \"T5\": dict(H=T5_H, h_id=hid5, span=span5, groups=z_groups(T5_H), kind=\"T5\", qaoa=None, hea=T5_HEA),\n}\nprint(\"QAOA\", QAOA, \"| T5 seed\", T5_SEED, \"cond\", round(t5_best, 3))\nprint(\"T1 h_id=%.4f span=%.4f | T5 h_id=%.4f span=%.4f\" % (hid1, span1, hid5, span5))\n","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-13T16:40:51.422537Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-13T16:40:51.422816Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-13T16:41:00.095476Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-13T16:40:51.422794Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-13T16:41:00.094701Z"},"jupyter":{"source_hidden":true}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"QAOA (0.8363636363636364, 0.37777777777777777) | T5 seed 130 cond 0.093\nT1 h_id=5.3600 span=7.0000 | T5 h_id=-1.3652 span=14.6377\n","output_type":"stream"}],"execution_count":19},{"id":"62a720d5-abad-46df-a1d9-a425f94cfd69","cell_type":"markdown","source":"## 4. Ojos + dispositivo (CPU/QPU)\n","metadata":{}},{"id":"ad5bac03-fb71-4fed-9733-3b66daba252d","cell_type":"code","source":"def per_qubit_friction(cal_dict, n_phys):\n    fr = np.zeros(n_phys)\n    for q in range(n_phys):\n        ro = float(cal_dict.get(q, {}).get(\"ro\", 0.02))\n        gx = float(cal_dict.get(q, {}).get(\"xerr\", 0.001))\n        fr[q] = min(1.0, 5.0 * ro + 50.0 * gx)\n    return fr\n\nclass SimDevice:\n    def __init__(self, M, tls_frac, stale_flip, time_drift, delta_good, delta_bad, seed=SEED):\n        self.M = M\n        rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)\n        self.bad = set(rng.choice(M, size=max(1, int(tls_frac * M)), replace=False).tolist())\n        self.stale_flip, self.time_drift = stale_flip, time_drift\n        self.delta_good, self.delta_bad = delta_good, delta_bad\n        self.rng = rng\n        self.cal = self._mk(True)\n        self.live = self._mk(False)\n\n    def _mk(self, stale):\n        cal = {}\n        for q in range(self.M):\n            bad = q in self.bad\n            base_ro = 0.01 + (self.delta_bad if bad else self.delta_good) * 0.05\n            base_x = 0.0005 + (self.delta_bad if bad else self.delta_good) * 0.002\n            if stale:\n                base_ro *= 1.0 + self.stale_flip * self.rng.random()\n                base_x *= 1.0 + self.stale_flip * self.rng.random()\n            cal[q] = dict(ro=base_ro, xerr=base_x)\n        return cal\n\n    def step(self):\n        for q in range(self.M):\n            drift = 1.0 + self.time_drift * self.rng.normal(0, 1) * 0.1\n            self.live[q][\"ro\"] = min(0.2, max(1e-4, self.live[q][\"ro\"] * abs(drift)))\n            self.live[q][\"xerr\"] = min(0.05, max(1e-5, self.live[q][\"xerr\"] * abs(drift)))\n\n    def noise_model(self):\n        nm = NoiseModel()\n        for q in range(self.M):\n            ro = self.live[q][\"ro\"]\n            nm.add_readout_error(ReadoutError([[1 - ro, ro], [ro, 1 - ro]]), [q])\n            xe = min(0.5, 2 * self.live[q][\"xerr\"])\n            nm.add_quantum_error(depolarizing_error(xe, 1), [\"x\", \"sx\"], [q])\n        for a in range(self.M - 1):\n            e = depolarizing_error(0.01, 2)\n            nm.add_quantum_error(e, [\"cx\"], [a, a + 1])\n            nm.add_quantum_error(e, [\"cx\"], [a + 1, a])\n        return nm\n\nbackend = sim_backend = device = None\nfr_cal = fr_live = None\nn_phys = None\n\nif MODE == \"cpu\":\n    device = SimDevice(**SIM)\n    fr_cal = per_qubit_friction(device.cal, device.M)\n    device.step()\n    fr_live = per_qubit_friction(device.live, device.M)\n    n_phys = device.M\n    cm = CouplingMap([[i, i + 1] for i in range(n_phys - 1)] + [[i + 1, i] for i in range(n_phys - 1)])\n    sim_backend = AerSimulator(\n        noise_model=device.noise_model(), coupling_map=cm,\n        basis_gates=[\"rz\", \"sx\", \"x\", \"cx\", \"measure\", \"delay\", \"id\", \"barrier\"])\n    MOTOR[\"ojos\"] = {\"active\": True, \"detail\": \"SimDevice fr_live mean=%.3f M=%d\" % (fr_live.mean(), n_phys)}\nelse:\n    from qiskit_ibm_runtime import QiskitRuntimeService\n    service = QiskitRuntimeService()\n    backend = service.backend(BACKEND_NAME)\n    n_phys = backend.num_qubits\n    props = backend.properties()\n    cal = {}\n    for q in range(n_phys):\n        try:\n            ro = props.readout_error(q)\n        except Exception:\n            ro = 0.02\n        try:\n            xe = props.gate_error(\"x\", [q])\n        except Exception:\n            xe = 0.001\n        cal[q] = dict(ro=float(ro), xerr=float(xe))\n    fr_cal = per_qubit_friction(cal, n_phys)\n    fr_live = fr_cal.copy()\n    MOTOR[\"ojos\"] = {\"active\": True, \"detail\": \"backend=%s fr mean=%.3f\" % (BACKEND_NAME, fr_live.mean())}\n\nprint(MOTOR[\"ojos\"][\"detail\"])\nif not MOTOR[\"ojos\"][\"active\"]:\n    raise RuntimeError(\"Ojos failed\")\n","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-13T16:41:00.096362Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-13T16:41:00.096710Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-13T16:41:00.197216Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-13T16:41:00.096679Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-13T16:41:00.196473Z"},"jupyter":{"source_hidden":true}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"SimDevice fr_live mean=0.115 M=14\n","output_type":"stream"}],"execution_count":20},{"id":"3ba0c44c-d9bc-4609-a6e0-23957295150f","cell_type":"markdown","source":"## 5. EQG conectado: Juicio + Reflejos + plan ON/OFF\n","metadata":{}},{"id":"c77fa9d0-407a-4152-a9b7-4f8d52fffb6c","cell_type":"code","source":"# coupling\nif MODE == \"cpu\":\n    edges = [[i, i + 1] for i in range(n_phys - 1)]\nelse:\n    edges = list(backend.coupling_map.get_edges())\n\nadj = defaultdict(list)\nfor a, b in edges:\n    adj[int(a)].append(int(b))\n    adj[int(b)].append(int(a))\n\ndef path_layouts(n_logical, blacklist, max_paths=40):\n    bl = set(int(x) for x in blacklist)\n    found = []\n    def dfs(path):\n        if len(found) >= max_paths:\n            return\n        if len(path) == n_logical:\n            found.append(list(path))\n            return\n        last = path[-1]\n        for nxt in sorted(adj[last], key=lambda q: fr_live[q] if q < len(fr_live) else 1.0):\n            if nxt in path:\n                continue\n            if nxt in bl and any(n not in path and n not in bl for n in adj[last]):\n                continue\n            dfs(path + [nxt])\n    starts = sorted(range(n_phys), key=lambda q: fr_live[q] if q < len(fr_live) else 1.0)\n    for s in starts:\n        if s in bl:\n            continue\n        dfs([s])\n        if len(found) >= max_paths:\n            break\n    return found or [list(range(n_logical))]\n\ndef score_layout(layout):\n    return float(np.mean([fr_live[q] if q < len(fr_live) else 1.0 for q in layout]))\n\n# --- Juicio PRE (governance) ---\nmean_fr = float(np.mean(fr_live))\nif mean_fr >= ABORT_FR_MEAN:\n    plan = dict(tipo=\"abortar\", reason=\"mean_fr=%.3f >= %.3f\" % (mean_fr, ABORT_FR_MEAN))\nelse:\n    plan = dict(tipo=\"continuar\", reason=\"mean_fr=%.3f OK\" % mean_fr)\nMOTOR[\"juicio\"] = {\"active\": True, \"detail\": \"%s | %s\" % (plan[\"tipo\"], plan[\"reason\"])}\nprint(\"[Juicio]\", MOTOR[\"juicio\"][\"detail\"])\nif plan[\"tipo\"] == \"abortar\":\n    raise RuntimeError(\"Juicio abortó PRE: \" + plan[\"reason\"])\n\n# --- Reflejos: layout  return qc\n\n_cache = {}\n_dd_pulses = defaultdict(int)\n\ndef make_circuit(hname, arm, block, gidx):\n    d = HAM[hname]\n    layout = LAYOUT_OFF if arm == \"OFF\" else LAYOUT_ON\n    prep = Análisis ON − OFF (claim de producto)\n","metadata":{}},{"id":"e54f6d8e-a970-40e0-95eb-89ca31d3c896","cell_type":"code","source":"def arm_agg(hname, arm, col, secol):\n    sub = df[(df.H == hname) & (df.arm == arm)]\n    x = sub[col].to_numpy(float)\n    se = sub[secol].to_numpy(float)\n    k = len(x)\n    se_shot = math.sqrt(np.nansum(se**2)) / max(k, 1)\n    se_between = float(np.std(x, ddof=1) / math.sqrt(k)) if k > 1 else 0.0\n    return float(np.nanmean(x)), max(se_shot, se_between), k\n\nrows = []\nfor hname in HAM:\n    for arm in ARMS:\n        m, s, k = arm_agg(hname, arm, \"HIS_span\", \"SE_span\")\n        mr, sr, _ = arm_agg(hname, arm, \"HIS_raw\", \"SE_raw\")\n        rows.append(dict(H=hname, arm=arm, bloques=k,\n                         HIS_span=round(m, 4), SE=round(s, 4),\n                         HIS_raw=round(mr, 4), SE_raw=round(sr, 4)))\nsummary = pd.DataFrame(rows)\nprint(summary.to_string(index=False))\n\ncontrasts = {}\nfor hname in HAM:\n    mon, son, _ = arm_agg(hname, \"ON\", \"HIS_span\", \"SE_span\")\n    moff, soff, _ = arm_agg(hname, \"OFF\", \"HIS_span\", \"SE_span\")\n    contrasts[hname] = dict(\n        delta=mon - moff, z=z_diff(mon, son, moff, soff),\n        HIS_ON=mon, HIS_OFF=moff)\n    mr_on, sr_on, _ = arm_agg(hname, \"ON\", \"HIS_raw\", \"SE_raw\")\n    mr_off, sr_off, _ = arm_agg(hname, \"OFF\", \"HIS_raw\", \"SE_raw\")\n    contrasts[hname][\"delta_raw\"] = mr_on - mr_off\n    contrasts[hname][\"z_raw\"] = z_diff(mr_on, sr_on, mr_off, sr_off)\n\nprint(\"\\n=== PRODUCTO: ON − OFF ===\")\nfor h, v in contrasts.items():\n    print(\"%s  ΔHIS_span=%+.4f  z=%.2f  | ON=%.4f OFF=%.4f\" % (\n        h, v[\"delta\"], v[\"z\"], v[\"HIS_ON\"], v[\"HIS_OFF\"]))\n\nproduct_pass = {\n    h: bool(contrasts[h][\"delta\"] > 0 and contrasts[h][\"z\"] >= 2)\n    for h in HAM\n}\n# criterio primario de producto: T5 (no ligado a MaxCut)\ngate = \"PRODUCTO_OK\" if product_pass.get(\"T5\") else \"PRODUCTO_NO\"\nprint(\"\\nPASS (Δ>0 & z≥2):\", product_pass)\nprint(\"Compuerta producto (T5):\", gate)\n","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-13T16:41:03.958180Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-13T16:41:03.958472Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-13T16:41:03.990529Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-13T16:41:03.958438Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-13T16:41:03.989424Z"},"jupyter":{"source_hidden":true}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":" H arm  bloques  HIS_span     SE  HIS_raw  SE_raw\nT1 OFF        4    0.9721 0.0016   0.9635  0.0021\nT1  ON        4    0.9710 0.0015   0.9621  0.0019\nT5 OFF        4    0.9856 0.0016   0.8452  0.0176\nT5  ON        4    0.9845 0.0020   0.8333  0.0210\n\n=== PRODUCTO: ON − OFF ===\nT1  ΔHIS_span=-0.0011  z=-0.49  | ON=0.9710 OFF=0.9721\nT5  ΔHIS_span=-0.0011  z=-0.43  | ON=0.9845 OFF=0.9856\n\nPASS (Δ>0 & z≥2): {'T1': False, 'T5': False}\nCompuerta producto (T5): PRODUCTO_NO\n","output_type":"stream"}],"execution_count":24},{"id":"01d9037a-b8f9-4ad8-bfa7-512e78360911","cell_type":"markdown","source":"## 9. Figuras y reporte\n","metadata":{}},{"id":"afd7b9fc-8ea5-4a83-9957-10dcf4e78424","cell_type":"code","source":"col = {\"OFF\": \"#c0392b\", \"ON\": \"#2980b9\"}\nfig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(13, 4))\nfor hi, hname in enumerate(HAM):\n    ax = axes[hi]\n    for k, arm in enumerate(ARMS):\n        sub = df[(df.H == hname) & (df.arm == arm)]\n        ax.errorbar(\n            np.full(len(sub), k) + 0.04 * (sub.block.to_numpy() % 3 - 1),\n            sub.HIS_span, yerr=sub.SE_span, fmt=\"o\", color=col[arm], alpha=0.85, capsize=2)\n        m, s, _ = arm_agg(hname, arm, \"HIS_span\", \"SE_span\")\n        ax.hlines(m, k - 0.3, k + 0.3, color=col[arm], lw=2)\n    ax.set_xticks([0, 1]); ax.set_xticklabels(ARMS)\n    ax.set_ylabel(\"HIS_span\"); ax.set_title(hname); ax.set_ylim(0.5, 1.05)\n\nax = axes[2]\nlabs = list(HAM.keys())\ndeltas = [contrasts[h][\"delta\"] for h in labs]\nerrs = [abs(contrasts[h][\"delta\"] / contrasts[h][\"z\"]) if abs(contrasts[h][\"z\"]) > EPS else 0.02 for h in labs]\nax.barh(labs, deltas, xerr=[2 * e for e in errs], color=\"#2980b9\")\nax.axvline(0, color=\"k\"); ax.set_xlabel(\"Δ HIS_span (ON−OFF)\"); ax.set_title(\"Producto\")\nplt.tight_layout()\nfig.savefig(OUT / \"eqg_onoff_summary.png\", dpi=140, bbox_inches=\"tight\")\nplt.show()\n\nreport = {\n    \"eqg_version\": EQG_VERSION, \"config_fingerprint\": FP, \"config\": CONFIG_SNAP,\n    \"motor\": MOTOR, \"juicio_pre\": plan,\n    \"layouts\": {\"OFF\": LAYOUT_OFF, \"ON\": LAYOUT_ON},\n    \"mode\": MODE, \"regime\": REGIME,\n    \"summary\": summary.to_dict(orient=\"records\"),\n    \"contrasts_ON_minus_OFF\": contrasts,\n    \"product_pass\": product_pass, \"gate\": gate,\n    \"dd_pulses\": dict(_dd_pulses),\n    \"records\": df.to_dict(orient=\"records\"),\n    \"created_utc\": time.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ\", time.gmtime()),\n    \"note_prior_sim\": \"Diagram EQG ΔHIS≈+0.24..+0.25; modular Aer C8 failed E=0\",\n}\npath = OUT / f\"eqg_onoff_report_{MODE}_{REGIME}.json\"\npath.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, default=lambda o: float(o) if hasattr(o, \"item\") else str(o)))\n(OUT / \"summary.txt\").write_text(\n    \"EQG=%s\\nfp=%s\\ngate=%s\\npass=%s\\nON-OFF=%s\\n\" % (\n        EQG_VERSION, FP, gate, product_pass,\n        {h: round(contrasts[h][\"delta\"], 4) for h in contrasts}))\nprint(\"Guardado:\", path)\nprint(\"RSS final ≈ %.0f MB\" % mem_mb())\nfor r in EQG_ROLES_REQUIRED:\n    print(\" \", r, MOTOR[r][\"active\"], MOTOR[r][\"detail\"])\n","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-13T16:41:03.992769Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-13T16:41:03.993089Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-13T16:41:04.578187Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-13T16:41:03.993061Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-13T16:41:04.577122Z"},"jupyter":{"source_hidden":true}},"outputs":[{"output_type":"display_data","data":{"text/plain":"<Figure size 1300x400 with 3 Axes>","image/png":"\n"},"metadata":{}},{"name":"stdout","text":"Guardado: eqg_onoff_cpu_stress/eqg_onoff_report_cpu_stress.json\nRSS final ≈ 355 MB\n  ojos True SimDevice fr_live mean=0.115 M=14\n  reflejos True OFF=[0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7] ON=[7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1, 0] score_on=0.111 blacklist=[]\n  juicio True continuar | mean_fr=0.115 OK\n  manos True ON=308 pulses | keys={'ON': 308, 'ON_preflight': 176, 'ON_conditional': 132}\n","output_type":"stream"}],"execution_count":25},{"id":"58f8af52-558e-483c-9ccc-a35709132b2f","cell_type":"markdown","source":"## Uso rápido\n\n1. **CPU:** `MODE=\"cpu\"` → Run All  \n2. **QPU ≤5 min:** `MODE=\"qpu\"`, `QPU_CONFIRM=True`, `REGIME=\"stress\"`  \n\n**Lectura de negocio:** `gate=PRODUCTO_OK` solo si T5 tiene Δ(ON−OFF)>0 y z≥2.  \n**Lectura modular previa:** el notebook de ablación A0/A/C/D/E sigue siendo el diagnóstico de piezas.\n\nCopyright (c) 2026 Arturo Salvador Balderas Hernández — Elastic License 2.0.  \nQiskit: Apache-2.0.
